description: This file defines the UserOptionsDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of user options in the OrchardCore CMS, including rendering views and handling form data.

classes.name: UserOptionsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for user options, handling display, editing, and updating user index options.

methods.name: BuildPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix for options to 'Options' for binding compatibility.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Builds the display view for user options, including bulk actions and filters.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the model for editing by mapping filter results and initializing views.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Maps form post data to filter results and delegates to EditAsync for further processing.

methods.name: BuildUserOptionsViewModel
methods.description: Copies properties from the main model to a view model for display or editing.
